_canonical: This file IS the badge map. Nothing else is. 02-source-map.md section 3 explains why it exists and how to change it, and deliberately does not repeat the list.
_match_rule: Lowercase the url host, strip a leading 'www.'. An entry matches if host == entry or host ends with '.'+entry. An entry containing '/' is host+path-prefix: host matches as above AND the url path begins with the prefix. Longest matching entry wins.
_no_match_rule: No match in any list -> source_badge 'Press', and append the bare host to index/unmapped_domains.json.
_drop_rule: Host in 'drop' -> do not create a row. If the same figure sits on a host already in this map, cite that host instead. If this repost is the ONLY reachable copy, keep the row, set source_badge 'Press', and set origin_publisher to the originating body.
_edit_rule: Edit this file in the data repo and commit. The weekly run fetches it every Monday and must never write to it — moving a domain between badges is a human decision taken between runs.
